prerequisites: Basic knowledge of electrical engineering and electronic components.

learning_outcomes.text: Students know power electronic components and the significance of their parameter influence.
Students who have successfully completed this module know the topology of basic power electronic circuits and can explain their behavior.
Students who have successfully completed this module can select a suitable converter circuit, calculate its steady-state operating points, and dimension the necessary components.
Students can verify the calculation of steady-state operating points using simulations and measurements on real systems.
Students who have successfully completed this module can analyze, solve, and document a problem in a group and present the results.

syllabus_topics: Line-commutated converter three-phase bridge circuit AC/three-phase controller
Self-commutated converter DC chopper pulse inverter
assessment_rules: The graded examination is either an oral examination or a written exam. The ungraded examination is an experimental work consisting of approximately 2 experiments. The duration of the oral examination is subject to the general examination regulations, and the written exam's duration is subject to the current study regulations.
